newsitem.title: USA: First Union seeks to buy Keystone - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: First Union seeks to buy Keystone - WSJ.

text.p: First Union Corp is in talks to acquire Keystone Investments Inc, a Boston fund firm that is one of the oldest mutual fund operators in the United States, The Wall Street Journal reported on Thursday.
The newspaper cited people familiar with the talks for the report. It is not clear how much First Union is offering.

However, based on an industry benchmark price of two percent of Keystone's $11.6 billion in assets under management, Keystone could fetch about $230 million. Keystone is closely held by employees of the firm.
The newspaper said First Union and Keystone declined to comment.
